verdict.rationale: The axis applies: AWS offers AI services such as Bedrock and AgentCore, so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from model training. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, an AI data-usage policy, or any control that keeps customer data out of model training. The Bedrock and AgentCore items describe model access and security in general terms only, which is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
